paper.title: Speeding Up Large-Wind-Farm Layout Optimization Using Gradients, Parallelization, and a Heuristic Algorithm for the Initial Layout
paper.authors: Rafael Valotta Rodrigues and Mads Mølgaard Pedersen and Jens Peter Schøler and Julian Quick and Pierre-Elouan Réthoré

public_asset_candidate_evidence.status: identity revision license checksums and semantics audited; dataset and PyWake model assets admitted

paper_source_conflicts: The paper describes the IEA simplified model with physical CT approximately 8/9 and also states equivalence to CT approximately 0.964; PyWake v2.5.0 uses CT=8/9 with D/sqrt(8) initial wake width.

The public helper defaults to 1000 SLSQP iterations while both public result tensors record max_iter=5000; neither pins the SciPy or TOPFARM revision, so the counter semantics and internal trajectory are not uniquely replayable in NLopt.
The public archive supplies processed NetCDF results and helper code, but no complete launch scripts, optimized coordinate arrays or Horns Rev timing arrays.
missing_information: complete environment lock, TOPFARM revision and SLSQP internal trajectory
all original random bitstreams and optimized coordinate arrays
full cluster affinity, scheduler state and memory measurement method
completion_decisions: Use exact PyWake v2.5.0 IEA-37, Horns Rev, Bastankhah, turbine and resource assets.
Freeze direct PyWake v2.5.0 AEP oracles for IEA-37 16/36/64 and Horns Rev 100 before performance admission.
Use a fixed pure-C++ reverse accumulation for the exact objective gradient and verify it against a 0.05 m central finite difference.
Use pinned NLopt Kraft SLSQP as the declared open replacement for the unpinned Python solver stack.

Use the public result tensors' 5000 SciPy-iteration setting only as provenance; separately cap production NLopt at 5000 objective callbacks and report actual objective, gradient and physical-layout counts.
Implement Algorithm 1 SMAST with the paper's 100-random_percent selection meaning and incremental candidate-state wake-square updates.
Treat complex-step as a non-target published comparator rather than inventing an unverified complex-valued solver.
Retain author NetCDF arrays as external validation evidence and run the platform's own 25 seeds from scratch.
Use all available Waffle cores for production; run one core only at sparse H6 timing points.
prior_parallel_boundary: The paper explicitly studies 1, 4, 16 and 32 CPU flow-case parallelization and recommends top-level multi-start parallelization. The platform claim is a deterministic, auditable pure-C++ realization and measured reproduction, not first parallelization.

scope.claim_boundary: source-backed flexible academic reproduction of both problem families SMAST exact-gradient SLSQP flow-case and multi-start parallelization; not author trajectory random stream exact timing/numerical replay complex-step implementation or first parallelization
